title: 一维峰值查找：问题定义与直接算法
titleEn: 1D Peak Finding: Problem Definition and Straightforward Algorithm

sections.heading: 峰值存在性与问题定义

items.text: 作业题：论证在「大于等于」定义下任何数组必然存在峰值（可去掉"如果存在"）。
items.textEn: Homework: argue that with the ">=" definition, any array always has a peak; the "if it exists" can be eliminated.

items.text: 若定义改为严格大于（">"），峰值不一定存在；此时算法必须能证明不存在或找到峰值。
items.textEn: With strict ">", a peak may not exist; the algorithm must prove nonexistence or find one.

items.text: 算法思维要点：设计通用算法，问题定义变化时仍有出发点解决第二版问题。
items.textEn: Design general algorithms so a changed problem definition still gives you a starting point.

items.text: 老师强调：穷尽搜索后要能论证"我穷尽了，确实找不到"，否则无法自证清白。
items.textEn: Emphasized: after exhaustive search, you must argue you searched exhaustively and couldn't find it.

sections.heading: 直接算法：从左向右扫描

items.text: 从最左端开始逐个向右扫描，直到遇到峰值。
items.textEn: Start from the left and walk across until a peak is found.

items.text: 峰值在数组右端时（如1,2,3,4,5,6）最坏，需检查全部 n 个元素。
items.textEn: Worst case: peak at far right (1,2,3,4,5,6), requiring all n elements.

items.text: 峰值恰在中点时约需检查 n/2 个元素。
items.textEn: If the peak is in the middle, about n/2 elements are checked.

items.text: 最坏情况复杂度为 Θ(n)：最坏需看全部 n 个元素。
items.textEn: Worst-case complexity is Theta(n): you may have to examine all n elements.

items.text: Θ(n) 同时给出上界和下界；O(n) 仅是上界。
items.textEn: Theta(n) gives both lower and upper bounds; Big O of n is just an upper bound.

items.text: 常数因子（如常数为1）可优化，但当前只关心渐近复杂度：该算法是线性的。
items.textEn: Constants may vary, but we only care about asymptotic complexity here: linear.

sections.heading: 更优思路：二分查找
sections.headingEn: Better Approach: Binary Search (Divide and Conquer)

items.text: 学生回答：看中间元素，哪一侧更高就只看哪一半，因为该侧必有峰值。
items.textEn: Student: check the middle; whichever side is higher must contain a peak, so cut the other half.

items.text: 教授确认正确：不断将搜索区间减半，降低渐近复杂度。
items.textEn: Professor confirmed: repeatedly halve the interval to lower the asymptotic complexity.
